title: Accommodation reimbursement precheck
goal: Check fictional reimbursement documents, identify missing evidence or business exceptions, and record only an isolated precheck status before human expense approval.

input_fields.label: Claimant
input_fields.description: Employee name on the reimbursement request.

input_fields.label: Claimed amount (USD)
input_fields.description: Amount entered on the claim; do not replace it with a corrected amount.

input_fields.label: Approved stay start
input_fields.description: Approved trip start date as written on the claim, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

input_fields.label: Approved stay end
input_fields.description: Approved trip end date as written on the claim, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

input_fields.label: Receipt addressee
input_fields.description: Exact Bill to name on the hotel payment document.

input_fields.label: Hotel guest
input_fields.description: Exact guest name on the hotel payment document.

input_fields.label: Hotel stay start
input_fields.description: Actual stay start stated on the hotel document, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

input_fields.label: Hotel stay end
input_fields.description: Actual stay end stated on the hotel document, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

input_fields.label: Employee-paid amount (USD)
input_fields.description: Employee card payment explicitly stated by the hotel; null if not stated. Never derive it by subtraction.

input_fields.label: Employee payment status
input_fields.description: Status of the employee payment, not the overall bill. Null when not stated.

input_fields.label: Total lodging charge (USD)
input_fields.description: Hotel total, which may include payments by different payers.

input_fields.label: Company prepayment (USD)
input_fields.description: Company payment explicitly stated by the hotel; null when not stated.

input_fields.label: Employee note
input_fields.description: Verbatim employee note. A note is not a manager's approval.

state_fields.label: Review status
state_fields.description: Isolated documentary precheck status; never a payment status.

actions.label: Complete documentary precheck
actions.description: Mark this isolated case ready for a manager's business approval. This is not expense approval or payment.

actions.label: Mark for correction
actions.description: Record a known document mismatch in this isolated case. Do not contact the claimant or change a payment.

actions.label: Hold for clarification or review
actions.description: Keep incomplete evidence or a business exception for human review in this isolated simulation.

rules.statement: A stay outside the recorded approved dates requires a manager's decision.

source_refs.quote: Use the approved stay dates recorded on the claim form. If either hotel stay date differs, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay; matching amounts do not resolve this exception.
Changed-trip necessity and exceptions to the approved stay remain a manager's business decision. A task-owner clarification of document checks does not grant that approval.

rules.statement: Return a known mismatch between the claimant and the hotel guest.

source_refs.quote: The hotel guest must match the claimant. A known guest-name mismatch is returned for correction.

rules.statement: Return a personal receipt when the stated paid employee amount differs from the claim.

source_refs.quote: For a receipt addressed to the claimant, use the explicitly stated employee-paid amount marked PAID. Compare the claim with that amount, not with a total that includes another payer.
For an accepted receipt with an identified employee payment marked PAID, a known amount mismatch is returned for correction.

rules.statement: Complete the documentary precheck for a matching personal receipt with an explicitly stated paid employee amount.

source_refs.quote: For a receipt addressed to the claimant, use the explicitly stated employee-paid amount marked PAID. Compare the claim with that amount, not with a total that includes another payer.

Mark the documentary precheck complete only when claimant and guest match, both stay dates match the approved dates, the receipt is accepted, and the claimed amount equals the stated employee-paid amount marked PAID.
READY_FOR_BUSINESS_APPROVAL means only that this documentary precheck is complete. RETURNED_FOR_CORRECTION and HELD are isolated simulation states, not communications or payment instructions.

rules.statement: Return a company-addressed folio when its explicitly stated paid employee amount differs from the claim.

source_refs.quote: For an accepted receipt with an identified employee payment marked PAID, a known amount mismatch is returned for correction.

If a required value, payer allocation or payment status is missing, hold and request the specific missing evidence. Do not subtract a company payment from a total, reverse-calculate from the claim, or infer who paid.

A folio addressed to Cedarline Services may be accepted for this precheck when the named guest matches the claimant, the employee-paid amount is explicitly identified, and that employee payment is marked PAID.
Compare the claimed amount directly with that stated employee-paid amount, not the total lodging charge. A known mismatch is returned for correction.
Do not calculate or infer a missing payment allocation. Hold and request evidence that explicitly identifies the employee-paid amount and its payment status.

rules.statement: Complete the precheck for an accepted company-addressed folio only when identity, approved stay dates and the explicitly stated paid employee amount match.

source_refs.quote: Mark the documentary precheck complete only when claimant and guest match, both stay dates match the approved dates, the receipt is accepted, and the claimed amount equals the stated employee-paid amount marked PAID.

If a required value, payer allocation or payment status is missing, hold and request the specific missing evidence. Do not subtract a company payment from a total, reverse-calculate from the claim, or infer who paid.
Changed-trip necessity and exceptions to the approved stay remain a manager's business decision. A task-owner clarification of document checks does not grant that approval.
READY_FOR_BUSINESS_APPROVAL means only that this documentary precheck is complete. RETURNED_FOR_CORRECTION and HELD are isolated simulation states, not communications or payment instructions.

A folio addressed to Cedarline Services may be accepted for this precheck when the named guest matches the claimant, the employee-paid amount is explicitly identified, and that employee payment is marked PAID.
Compare the claimed amount directly with that stated employee-paid amount, not the total lodging charge. A known mismatch is returned for correction.
Do not calculate or infer a missing payment allocation. Hold and request evidence that explicitly identifies the employee-paid amount and its payment status.
Both hotel stay dates must match the approved stay dates. A changed stay still requires a manager's decision; this clarification does not approve an extension.
Matching evidence permits only READY_FOR_BUSINESS_APPROVAL in the isolated simulation, never final expense approval or payment.
